Name: Clothes Give Buffs - Hats Shirts Shoes - plus More Clothes
Author: ApryllForever
Description:
[center][color=#ff00ff][size=6]Brief Description:[/size][/color][/center]

Clothes can now give you buffs! These buffs are stackable, and in general based on the rough approximation of what the clothing article is; for example, overalls give farming buffs, breastplates give defense buffs, fishing clothes give fishing buffs, etc. You can tell what buff is applied by hovering over the item in your inventory! 

A few of the clothes also gives different dialogues! 

Adds new clothing - mermaid themed, of course! This clothing can be obtained by breaking barrels or cutting weeds.

When wearing certain clothing, breaking barrels will drop certain additional items!

[color=#9900ff][center][size=5]Additional Features:[/size][/center][/color]

[color=#ff00ff]Long Vest (Abigail Shirt!) + Green Tunic (Link Sirt - Zelda)[/color]
When breaking barrels or cutting weeds, these two give a chance to get gold, health, or bombs! Also make a cool power up sound! (There's not an in-game Link like sound... )

[color=#00ffff]Mermaid Clothes:[/color]
The clothes added by this mod, especially the Cuirasses, give drops also when breaking barrels!

Heart Shirts give health! :)

[i]When I get a chance later, will document the additional clothes which produce drops! :)[/i]
